title: A guard refuses a posted review record whose Head is not the PR's live head
why: Incident about 15:10 CST Nov 7: lane notes-fix-page posted a review record on #1475 with a hand-typed wrong head tail.
note: The guard refuses a GitHub comment post whose body holds the review-record marker unless the record's Head is the PR's live head and its PR line names the target PR. Topic review-rounds. Guard change, full review rounds. Red test first. Sighting and scope add (lane lane-lint-hook-suites, 05:49 CST Nov 8; its proposed step review-record-sha-exists is folded here): at 05:27 CST the lane posted a #1916 review record with a hand-typed Head whose tail it invented, and fixed it within a minute. The live-head check here covers Head; also refuse a Fix check sha that is no commit (`git cat-file -e`). Two more sightings (lane notes-fix-other-2, 07:02 CST Nov 8; proposed steps review-record-sha-from-git and review-record-posts-via-tool, folded here on the coordinator's word): a hand-typed wrong 40-character Head on #1626, fixed by a comment edit; and a hand-built #1507 record with an extra paragraph above the `---` line, which broke the record parse. Done check adds: the tool posts exactly what it renders, with Head from git. Sighting (lane windows-stamp-suite-hang, 07:21 CST Nov 8; proposed step record-comment-from-tool, folded here on the coordinator's word): on #1990 a hand-typed review-record comment with a short head (662f87d4d) was posted before the tool's printed record (comment 6722024555); nothing refused a hand-typed record comment.
